about: KEL v2 negative cases: each kel (MarshalKEL bytes, or bytes written by hand for the encoding cases) must fail UnmarshalKEL or Replay with exactly the error text given. Keys are those of KEL-2A and KEL-2B and the label anet-golden/v016/KEL-2N/attacker.
